summary: PBF Energy's indirect subsidiary PBF Holding and co-issuer PBF Finance filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026 announcing a notice of optional full redemption of all $800.0 million aggregate principal amount of outstanding 9.875% Senior Notes due 2030. Redemption is set for October 26, 2026 at 100% of principal plus an Applicable Premium under the March 17, 2025 indenture and accrued unpaid interest. No board recommendation, advisor, premium to market, or takeout financing is disclosed, leaving the funding source and balance-sheet impact unstated. Watch for tender/redemption economics versus open-market trading levels and any replacement financing.
